data.title: Supported Model II CP/M and Abacus configuration released

actions.description: Scenario customer release within the historical October US shipping window: supported 64 KB CP/M configuration, Model II Abacus and the separately supported FlexiBUS option. Release follows disk, printing, save/reopen, native UI and interface qualification; publish resource limits. October 15 is a scenario-selected day. OEM economics and Tandy system prices are not inferred from Aurelia retail prices.
